scholarships.title: CSHL School of Biological Sciences Ph.D. Program (Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory)
scholarships.official_source: Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory, School of Biological Sciences

eligibility: Hold a bachelor's degree or equivalent by the time of enrolment
Apply online through the School's application system
Submit unofficial transcripts, a personal statement and three letters of recommendation
Submit TOEFL or IELTS scores if from a non-English language university
No GRE and no minimum GPA requirement
Backgrounds in any area of biology, or in computer science, engineering, mathematics, chemistry or physics, are accepted
existing.eligibility_summary: Applicants must hold a bachelor's degree or equivalent by the time they enrol. The School welcomes applicants from any area of biology as well as non-bioscience backgrounds such as computer science, engineering, mathematics, chemistry and physics. Students from non-English language universities must submit TOEFL or IELTS scores. The GRE general test and subject tests are not required and there is no minimum GPA.
benefits: All tuition costs and associated study fees paid by the School
New laptop plus software and textbooks worth roughly $3,500
$2,000 per year research cost allowance once in a lab
Affordable on-campus child care and a $350 gym membership allowance

application_method: Apply online through the CSHL School of Biological Sciences application system using the APPLY NOW link on the How to Apply page
Read the Frequently Asked Questions page and the brochure and catalogue for full process detail
Arrange the three recommendation letters so they arrive with the application
existing.selection_notes: Application review is holistic: all components are considered, including the types of courses taken, the applicant's research experience and any challenges faced. Letters of recommendation are highly valued. The School recruits a diverse student group and especially encourages applicants from groups not traditionally represented in the biological sciences.
existing.best_fit: Students with a bachelor's degree or equivalent who want a small, mentorship-intensive biosciences PhD with all tuition and a $50,000 annual stipend paid automatically on admission, from any scientific background including non-biosciences.
existing.notes: Funding is automatic on admission rather than a separate scholarship application; the School states it 'pays all tuition costs and associated study fees for its students'. The stipend figure of $50,000 per year is described as current and rises to $55,000, or the external fellowship amount if higher, for students who hold an external award. No service obligation is published.
existing.duration: Approximately five years from matriculation to PhD; the average time to degree is reported as 5.19 years
existing.application_period: Applications are open now and must be submitted online by December 1 each year. Each year 8 or 9 students join the programme, with applicants drawn from more than 20 US states and 25 countries.
existing.program_type: Research institute doctoral programme with automatic full funding
